about_the_game:
The long-awaited third volume of the FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS soundtrack is now available!

Nearly two years and eight months since the previous release, this new album features 27 tracks — including music from Season 3, previously unreleased tracks from Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 soundtracks, and selections from Season 4.

Once again produced by Noriyasu Agematsu, the soundtrack delivers a rich collection of delicate, beautiful, and powerful compositions that bring the epic world of FINAL FANTASY BRAVE EXVIUS to life.
